decisions.reason: Approving optional tip presets and a custom tip amount does not change the Transak provider, fiat methods, conversion asset, or buyer-access requirements.
The $30 tip preset is an optional gratuity choice and does not change the separate $30 mint price or required revenue allocation.
The optional tip controls do not affect the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
The tip amount options do not change how commissions are allocated when a mint has no referral code.
The tip design does not alter the referral code source, persistence, or display locations.
Optional gratuity choices during minting do not change the amount, structure, disclosure, or pool treatment of secondary-sale royalties.
The optional tip configuration does not change coded-referral commission amounts, triggers, recipients, or payout behavior.
The source exchange approves the mint-page tipping design but does not request or necessarily entail any change to the approved FAQ copy.
The gratuity presets and custom amount option do not change Small Block winners, prize amounts, eligibility, or draw triggers.
The tip interface approval does not alter SIWE authentication or the wallet-protected mint and transfer flows.
The optional tip amounts do not change Big Block winner count, prize amount, or draw condition.
Approval of the mint-page tip design does not necessarily revise the About-page copy or resolve its separate prize-payout ambiguity.
